prompt: At 2:30 the event feed starts lagging again. A quick switch fixes the problem. What should the incident record show?
promptZh: 兩點半，正式活動訊號的字幕再次延遲。快速切換訊號後恢復正常。事件紀錄應如何處理？

options.text: Keep the room and time in the record, even though the fix worked.
options.zh: 即使已經修好，仍在紀錄保留會場與發生時間。
options.whyZh: 14:20 的流程要求記下發生地點及時間，且即使立刻修好也要留存。

options.text: Reopen the glossary request and add the host’s name.
options.zh: 重開詞庫需求並加上主持人的名字。
options.whyZh: 詞庫需求和時間事件應分開。

options.text: Wait to see whether the fix succeeds before writing anything.
options.zh: 先等修復結果，再寫紀錄。
options.whyZh: 紀錄要求切換前就記下細節，即使立刻修好也要保留。

options.text: Turn off captions on the recording copy.
options.whyZh: 流程沒有要求關錄影字幕。

explanationZh: 14:20 的流程要求記下發生地點及時間，且即使立刻修好也要留存。
evidence: If lag returns on the event feed, note the room and time before switching feeds. … Record the details even if an immediate change restores the captions.
